pk.context: 0.4 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: olive green and orange hard gelatin capsule

clues.kinetics: Absorption exceeds 90% when fasting, and fasting raises exposure 30% over fed. It is 94% to 99% bound to plasma proteins and mainly cleared by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, with under 10% excreted unchanged.
clues.substance: Molecular weight 408.5 for the active moiety. A white crystalline powder that melts with decomposition near 230°C.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA as 0.4 mg capsules, taken once a day.
clues.safety: No boxed warning. Contraindicated in hypersensitivity to it or any capsule component; headache and dizziness are the most common reactions.
clues.indication: Signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia, but not for the treatment of hypertension.
clues.mechanism: Blocks alpha 1A adrenoceptors in the prostate, so smooth muscle relaxes and urine flow improves.

tell: Absorption-controlled kinetics stretch this alpha-1 blocker's half-life to 9 to 13 hours, versus 5 to 7 hours for immediate release.

evidence.pk.tmaxH: reached by 4 to 5 hours under fasting conditions
evidence.pk.halfLifeH: the apparent half-life of tamsulosin hydrochloride is approximately 9 to 13 hours in healthy volunteers
evidence.pill: Capsule: 0.4 mg, olive green and orange hard gelatin
clues.kinetics: Absorption of tamsulosin hydrochloride from FLOMAX capsules 0.4 mg is essentially complete (>90%) following oral administration under fasting conditions
Taking FLOMAX capsules under fasted conditions results in a 30% increase in bioavailability (AUC)
Tamsulosin hydrochloride is extensively bound to human plasma proteins (94% to 99%)
Tamsulosin is extensively metabolized, mainly by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6
less than 10% of the dose is excreted in urine unchanged
clues.substance: Tamsulosin hydrochloride is a white crystalline powder that melts with decomposition at approximately 230°C
clues.safety: FLOMAX capsules are contraindicated in patients known to be hypersensitive to tamsulosin hydrochloride or any component of FLOMAX capsules
The most common adverse events (≥2% of patients and at a higher incidence than placebo) with the 0.4 mg dose or 0.8 mg dose were headache, dizziness
clues.indication: indicated for the treatment of the signs and symptoms of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH)
FLOMAX capsules are not indicated for the treatment of hypertension
clues.mechanism: Tamsulosin hydrochloride is an antagonist of alpha 1A adrenoceptors in the prostate
Blockade of these adrenoceptors can cause smooth muscles in the bladder neck and prostate to relax, resulting in an improvement in urine flow rate
